items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: And Cleo on bass, you heard talk of him?

ctx.x: Pouché, that's it. He's the one. Well practically the band was almost the same. After Sam got out of it for a while and then Isaiah began to get younger fellas like Albert ! He was playing first trumpet and Isaiah Morgan playing second. Well that's the time they began to get rough. And Cleo on bass, you heard talk of him? Oh yeah. Yeah, well guys like him, great young bitch, I mean come up, I mean after Jim you know.
I never did know his full name Cleo.
